pm-ryan: Postmortem follow-up: create a short-lived remediation cadence for streaming/chat reconnects, partial responses, and timeout spikes. Goal = single bridge team until 14 clean days. Need owners, quick mitigations, and CI sim.

Sanjay: I'll own the reconnect client lib + tests. Plan: exp backoff + jitter, cap at 2s, max_retries=4. Will ensure KV cache resume is idempotent. Ticket RED-12345.

Maria: I'll add `partial_chunk_detected` metric + Prom alert. Suggest page if >3/min sustained 2m in prod. I'll add a region heatmap to Grafana. Ticket RED-12346.

Ken: I'll write a one-page runbook (detect -> retry -> fallback -> escalate) with rollback commands, and own the canary rollout. Ticket RED-12347.

Elaine: I'll wire the routing fallback to a smaller same-region variant and add a flag `X-Fallback-Used` for tracing. Ticket RED-12348.

pm-ryan: Concrete short list: RED-12345 (Sanjay) reconnect lib + CI harness; RED-12346 (Maria) metric+alert+dashboard; RED-12347 (Ken) runbook+canary; RED-12348 (Elaine) fallback wiring. Owners add acceptance criteria & tests today.

Sanjay: Implementation note: client logs must include `request_id`, `session_id`, `last_chunk_index`, `kv_resume_token`. Adding small shim.

Ken: ops-bot, please create recurring 2-week bridge cadence Mon/Wed 30m.

ops-bot: Recurring event created: "Streaming Reconnect Bridge" Mon/Wed 30m starting 2026-03-30. Invites sent.

deploy-bot: staging deploy queued: reconnect-lib v0.9.9 by Sanjay. CI green. Scheduled 2026-03-27T02:00:00Z.

pm-ryan: Follow-ups: owners update RED tickets with AC & test plan today; Ken to publish runbook link; reconvene next Tue for rollup. Escalate to P0 on any sustained partial_chunk spikes.
